data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price – brand new in 2012): Approx. ₱828,000 – ₱1,058,000 (Varied by trim and transmission)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,530 × 1,775 × 1,435 Wheelbase (mm): 2,700 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
1.6 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline (Gamma MPI)
Maximum Output: ~130 hp Maximum Torque: ~157 Nm
1.8 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline (Nu MPI)
Maximum Output: ~148 hp Maximum Torque: ~178 Nm
Transmission: 6-speed Manual or 6-speed Automatic Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not officially rated; compact sedans not meant for towing
Payload Capacity: Approx. 430–500 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 48 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Infotainment: Basic audio (radio / CD / USB), upgraded head units on higher trims
Speakers: 4–6 (depending on variant)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Solid Disc or Drum (variant-dependent)
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Multi-Link rear
Tires / Wheels: 195/65 R15 or 205/55 R16 (alloy for higher trims)
